items.title: CVE-2026-76466: Cisco TelePresence Video Communication Server (VCS) Expressway remote code execution as root in database service (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A flaw in the database service of Cisco Expressway Series (the Expressway-C and Expressway-E devices) lets an attacker run operating system commands as root on the underlying system. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-123890: VMware vCenter authentication bypass in directory service (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. An authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service affects VMware vCenter, as well as VMware Telco Cloud Platform and Telco Cloud Infrastructure. An attacker can exploit it remotely, without logging in, to skip authentication, which could give them full control over the affected systems.

items.title: CVE-2026-129448: Apache Roller unauthenticated code execution in XML-RPC endpoint (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Apache Roller has a deserialization flaw in its XML-RPC endpoint that lets a remote attacker run arbitrary code on the server without logging in. The endpoint deserializes vendor extension types before it checks the requester's identity.

items.title: CVE-2026-49869: Kestra code execution via auth bypass in AuthenticationFilter (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Kestra, an open-source orchestration platform, has an authentication bypass that lets an attacker create and run arbitrary workflows, giving them remote code execution as root inside the Kestra worker container. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and because the bug is listed in CISA's catalog of known exploited vulnerabilities, attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-126714: PHP remote code execution via partially written session files (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. PHP's default file-based session handler can leave a session file with a mix of new and old data if a write is interrupted, so an attacker who can influence session data may inject objects and, if the application contains a suitable gadget chain, run code on the server. The attacker can reach this remotely without logging in, though the attack depends on interrupting a write at the right moment.

items.title: CVE-2026-129496: PHP remote code execution in timezone cache (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A use-after-free bug in the timezone cache of PHP (from the PHP Group), in non-thread-safe builds where a startup warning is written to a file-based error log, lets an attacker crash PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php or CGI workers. Arbitrary code execution may also be possible. The attacker can reach it remotely, without logging in, by sending a crafted request.

items.title: Buffer overflow in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder enables unauthenticated RCE
items.summary: CVE-2026-114938, which the researcher Calif is calling Java4Shell, is a buffer overflow in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder. The optimized decoder miscalculates the store mask for the padded tail of its input and writes past the end of the output buffer. The bug lives in the JIT-compiled fast path behind java.util.Base64.Decoder , so any application that decodes attacker-controlled Base64 can reach it. Login headers and file uploads are the obvious entry points. items.title: CVE-2026-132660: EnterpriseDB Postgres Enterprise Manager remote code execution via SECURITY DEFINER search path
items.summary: EnterpriseDB's Postgres Enterprise Manager has several privileged database functions that don't use a safe search path, so a user who can connect to its backend database can plant objects that the functions use in their place. Over the network with only a low-privilege login and no user interaction, an attacker can use this to run arbitrary SQL with superuser privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-19030
items.summary: Observable Discrepancy vulnerability in Drupal CAPTCHA for Drupal 7 allows unauthenticated attackers to test login credentials despite CAPTCHA protection. When CAPTCHA is enabled on Drupal login forms, normal form validation can still run after a missing or incorrect CAPTCHA response. This may expose credential validation feedback and allow an attacker to distinguish invalid credentials from valid credentials paired with a failed CAPTCHA. This issue affects CAPTCHA for Drupal 7: from 7.x-1.0 through 7.x-1.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-129840
items.summary: In the nrfconnect/ncs-zigbee repository, the GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/build_documentation.yml used the pull_request_target trigger while checking out and executing untrusted pull request code. This allowed a pull request from a fork to run attacker-controlled code in the base repository context with a write-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN (contents: write, pages: write, pull-requests: write), enabling remote code execution in CI, token exfiltration, and unauthorized modification of repository content and GitHub Pages. The workflow was disabled and then rewritten to remove the issue.

A successful exploit could allow an attacker to bypass authentication and perform unauthorized actions within the context of the application. This is MTLVULN-1877.

items.title: CVE-2026-120271
items.summary: InfoScan contains an unauthenticated information disclosure vulnerability in its mobile-enumeration and version-reporting endpoints. A remote attacker can send HTTP requests without authentication to retrieve system configuration information, including usernames and display names, multifactor authentication configuration status, session settings, application version information, server details, hardware module firmware versions, and the BACnet/IP port used by the installation.

items.title: CVE-2026-129396
items.summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Arbitrary file write leading to remote code execution in CSS editor in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.3, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - The CSS editor did not restrict file names, extensions and paths of created and saved files, allowing privileged backend users to write arbitrary PHP files.

items.title: CVE-2026-82339
items.summary: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to missing authentication in the SharePoint S-TAP RelayService, allowing an unauthenticated network attacker to inject forged audit events and access the active monitoring policy.

items.title: CVE-2026-77318
items.summary: Jupyter MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol server for Jupyter. Prior to 1.0.3, standalone streamable-http mode can enforce MCP_TOKEN on /mcp while leaving the state-changing /api/connect and /api/stop management routes unauthenticated. An unauthenticated network caller can use /api/connect to replace runtime_url and document_url values and their tokens, reset ServerContext, and start a kernel client against attacker-controlled infrastructure, causing the server to send Jupyter API and WebSocket traffic to that backend. The caller can also use /api/stop to stop the current notebook kernel.…

items.title: CVE-2026-130163
items.summary: Collabora Online is a collaborative online office suite based on LibreOffice technology. Prior to 24.04.19.3, 25.04.13.3, and 26.04.3.3, the RouteToken query parameter is reflected into the unauthenticated admin-console page without HTML encoding. The admin-console page is served without authentication. A victim must load a crafted URL, and token exposure requires the victim to be an administrator already signed in to the console; the reflected value can run script in the Collabora Online origin and expose the console authentication token. This issue is fixed in versions 24.04.19.3, 25.04.13.3…

items.title: CVE-2026-129932
items.summary: The MongoDB Java driver applies its DNS seedlist domain restriction to a record value that is later re-interpreted differently when the connection target is parsed, so the name that is checked and the name that is used can differ. An unauthenticated party who can set or forge the DNS service record for the seed domain in a connection string can cause the driver to direct its session to an unrelated host and to complete certificate verification against that host instead. This may result in unintended disclosure of application data and of configured database credentials, and in unintended conten…

items.title: CVE-2026-77336
items.summary: Aperi'Solve is an open-source steganalysis web platform. Prior to 3.4.2, an unauthenticated user can submit a PNG to POST /upload, which reaches aperisolve/utils/png.py through analyze_image, PCRTAnalyzer, PNG.repair(), and check_idat(). A malformed IDAT chunk can make attacker-controlled length and newline data drive an unbounded combinations search in PNG._fix_dos2unix(), causing repeated CRC checks that occupy a worker and delay or block image analysis for other users. Per-IP upload limits and eventual job termination bound the denial of service, and the issue has no confidentiality or inte…

items.title: CVE-2026-133311
items.summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker, with knowledge of a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content, to conduct an unauthorized access attack due to improper authentication mechanisms. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to obtain sensitive information. The vulnerability is limited to the affected functionality and does not provide unrestricted access to arbitrary files elsewhere on the system. This is MTLVULN-1863.

items.title: CVE-2026-77369
items.summary: Daptin is a GraphQL/JSON-API headless CMS. The YJS initial-content provider then reads the selected file.* column without CanRead or CanUpdate checks, and bidirectional synchronization allows a low-privileged authenticated user to read or modify restricted row content. Unauthenticated requests are rejected, and standalone non-canonical room names remain shared-by-name room…

Prior to 0.12.30, the generic GET /api/{entity} list endpoint accepts attacker-controlled sort values in PaginatedFindAllWithoutFilters in server/resource/resource_findallpaginated.go without validating the requested column against the table schema. items.title: CVE-2026-133323
items.summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct a blind command injection attack due to insufficient parameter sanitization. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1864.

items.title: CVE-2026-115578
items.summary: Go-Guerrilla SMTP Daemon is a lightweight SMTP server written in Go. In 1.6.7 and earlier, according to the repository advisory's structured affected range, server.go defines the seven-byte cmdXCLIENT token, but the XCLIENT handler slices input[8:] after matching only that seven-byte verb, so a bare command causes an out-of-bounds panic in handleClient and terminates the daemon because that connection goroutine does not recover the panic. The issue is reachable by an unauthenticated client when the non-default xclient_on setting is enabled; no HELO command is required. The repository fix is pr…

items.title: CVE-2026-77379
items.summary: Bolt is a fully open source, adaptable platform for building and running modern websites. Prior to 6.1.4, the public Relation API lacks an access-control filter. Unauthenticated users can query its REST endpoints and GraphQL endpoints to discover metadata about unpublished, draft, and viewless content. This issue is fixed in version 6.1.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-133303
items.summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to leverage pre-staged malicious content to conduct an XML injection attack due to insufficient parameter validation. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1862.

items.title: CVE-2026-133275
items.summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct an arbitrary file upload attack due to insufficient file type validation. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to upload arbitrary files to the target system. This is MTLVULN-1861.

items.title: CVE-2026-129938
items.summary: An improper neutralization of delimiters in the MongoDB C# driver's DNS SRV connection-string resolution lets an unauthenticated party who can answer the client's DNS SRV query place a host outside the trusted domain into the client's server list. When an application resolves the connection string through the affected API and connects with the result, application data, authentication credentials and query results may pass through that host. This may result in unintended disclosure of data and credentials and in forged query results.

items.title: CVE-2026-126088
items.summary: In Autonomy Logic OpenPLC Runtime versions 4.2.4 and prior, a race condition allows multiple concurrent requests to pass the existence check before any user is committed, resulting in several unauthenticated admin accounts being created.

items.summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated SQL injection in frontend data view filters in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - Sorting, location radius and published filters of the frontend data view were not properly sanitized, allowing SQL injection, partly without authentication.

items.title: CVE-2026-129402
items.summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated SQL injection in reload task in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - Input placeholders in SQL field statements were inserted without quoting in the public reload task, allowing unauthenticated SQL injection in read queries.

Third-party plugins whose portlets evaluate…

items.title: CVE-2026-129403
items.summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Missing access check in reload task in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - The public reload task did not check form and field access levels, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve results of SQL field statements of restricted forms.

items.title: CVE-2026-133200
items.summary: A flaw was found in quarkus-vertx-utils. When a client disconnects while receiving a streaming response, the server fails to detect the closed connection and continues processing the data indefinitely. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this issue by repeatedly initiating streaming requests and disconnecting, exhausting worker threads and resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

items.title: CVE-2026-22310
items.summary: When the setting for saving requests to non-existent pages (404) is enabled, JTL-Shop stores the raw requested URL in its redirect table, and the administration backend renders it without output encoding in the form used to edit a redirect. An unauthenticated remote attacker can store script code with a single request, which is executed in the browser session of an administrator who opens the affected redirect, allowing actions to be performed with the administrator's privileges. The setting is disabled by default in new installations but may still be enabled in older ones.

items.title: CVE-2026-77338
items.summary: Sprout Track is a self-hosted baby tracking application. Prior to 1.3.5, Sprout Track uses a publicly known hardcoded signing secret when JWT_SECRET is unset, and standard setup does not generate a unique secret. On a network-reachable affected deployment, an unauthenticated attacker can sign JWTs with arbitrary claims, including system-administrator claims, to access administrative functionality and read or modify family, child activity, account, and email data. Deployments with a strong unique JWT_SECRET are not affected. Managed and hosted instances were reported remediated. This issue is f…

items.title: Are You Sure That Software Is Legit?
items.summary: Downloading a software package doesn't automatically mean you're getting the legitimate version. Checking cryptographic hashes, such as SHA-256, can help verify that a downloaded file matches the expected release. Developers and security teams often rely on automated scripts, package managers, plugins, and external repositories. Without proper integrity verification, malicious or modified software can make its way into trusted environments. Checking version numbers alone isn't sufficient. items.title: CVE-2026-133710
items.summary: llama.cpp b11003 before b12556 contains an integer overflow in the hrm_text loader load_arch_hparams() that allows attackers to bypass the block count check using crafted GGUF metadata. Attackers can supply a GGUF model whose layer factors wrap modulo 2^32, causing load_arch_tensors() to write tensor pointers past model.layers, corrupting heap memory and potentially enabling code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-133430
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. This vulnerability allows an authenticated remote attacker to cause a denial of service by terminating active sessions of arbitrary users. When processing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) documents that lack a root signature, Keycloak accepts the request as long as any assertion within the document is signed, without verifying its context or placement. An attacker holding a validly signed assertion can embed it into an unsigned logout request for another user, causing Keycloak to accept the forged request and terminate the victim's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-133430
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. This vulnerability allows an authenticated remote attacker to cause a denial of service by terminating active sessions of arbitrary users. When processing Security Assertion Markup Language SAML documents that lack a root signature, Keycloak accepts the request as long as any assertion within the document is signed, without verifying its context or placement. An attacker holding a validly signed assertion can embed it into an unsigned logout request for another user, causing Keycloak to accept the forged request and terminate the victim's session...

items.title: CVE-2026-129814
items.summary: The SDO Information Get Object Description and Get Entry Description responses copy the object or entry name into the mailbox data area and then write a null terminator byte. The copy loops ran up to the last available byte in the buffer, leaving no room for the terminator. When an object or entry name exactly fills the available space the terminator is written one byte past the end of the mailbox data buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129813
items.summary: The CoE complete-access download handler iterated over all subindices of an object and wrote the master-supplied payload into each writable entry. Entries that hold a constant have write-access flags set but carry a NULL data pointer. The handler did not check for this and wrote the master payload through the NULL pointer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129812
items.summary: An object dictionary entry that holds a constant has no process data storage and carries a NULL data pointer. sizeOfPDO did not check for this when resolving a mapped entry to its descriptor. A master that maps such an entry to a PDO causes COE_pdoPack or COE_pdoUnpack to dereference the NULL data pointer on every process data exchange after the mapping is activated.

items.title: CVE-2026-129811
items.summary: The PDO mapping bit lengths stored in the mapping objects are writable by the master via SDO. sizeOfPDO summed them without checking the total against the size of the rxpdo[] or txpdo[] process data buffers. A master can craft a mapping whose total bit count exceeds those buffers, causing COE_pdoPack and COE_pdoUnpack to write past their ends during each process data cycle after the PREOP to SAFEOP transition.

items.title: CVE-2026-129810
items.summary: ESC_eoeprocess and ESC_eoeprocess_tx can be reached before the application calls EOE_config to supply the callback table pointer. When eoe_cfg is NULL the receive handler dereferenced it while processing an incoming EoE frame, and the transmit polling function dereferenced it on each cycle, causing NULL pointer dereferences.

items.title: CVE-2026-129809
items.summary: ESC_foeprocess can be reached by an incoming mailbox frame before the application calls FOE_config to supply the file table and flush buffer pointers. When foe_cfg or its fbuffer field is NULL the handler dereferenced those pointers while processing the frame, causing a NULL pointer dereference.

items.title: CVE-2026-129808
items.summary: The EoE receive and transmit paths call the handle_recv_buffer and fetch_send_buffer callbacks without first checking whether they are set. Both callbacks are documented as optional; an application that omits either one causes a call through a NULL function pointer when the first EoE frame arrives or when the transmit polling loop runs.

items.title: CVE-2026-129807
items.summary: The FoE file table allows entries to omit a write handler by setting write_function to NULL, making the file read-only. FOE_fopen did not check whether write_function was present before accepting a write request; a master sending a WRQ for a read-only file caused a call through a NULL function pointer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129806
items.summary: The CoE SDO upload handler enters its normal-response path (used for objects longer than 4 bytes) and passes (objd + nsub)->data directly to the pre-object handler and to the response copy. Entries that hold a constant in the value field have data set to NULL; a master can request such an entry and cause a NULL pointer dereference in the upload path.

items.title: CVE-2026-129805
items.summary: An object dictionary entry can carry write-access flags and still have a NULL data pointer, for example when a constant value is held in the value field rather than in addressable storage. The CoE SDO download handler checked write access but not whether storage was present, then wrote the master-supplied payload through the NULL pointer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129804
items.summary: FOE_read and FOE_write store the filename length as uint8_t, truncating it modulo 256. When (mbxheader.length - ESC_FOEHSIZE) is a multiple of 256, the length becomes 0. Additionally, a request whose mailbox length equals ESC_FOEHSIZE exactly also produces a length of 0 without any truncation. In both cases FOE_fopen calls strncmp with a length of 0, which always returns equal, so the first registered file whose password is 0 is opened regardless of the filename the master sent.

items.title: CVE-2026-129803
items.summary: The CoE entry gate accepts frames with mbxheader.length as low as COE_MINIMUM_LENGTH (8), but a normal SDO Download requires at least COE_HEADERSIZE (10) bytes of CoE payload to carry its header fields. With mbxheader.length of 8 or 9, the segmented-transfer branch misevaluates due to unsigned wrap, leaving the declared SDO size unclamped. copy2mbx then reads that many bytes starting past the end of the actual payload and writes them into the object buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129802
items.summary: EOE_set_ip reads each network parameter field (MAC, IP, subnet, gateway, DNS IP, DNS name) from the mailbox payload before checking whether the payload is large enough to contain them. The single bounds check at the end of the function does not prevent the reads from happening. A master can send a Set-IP frame with all flags set and mbxheader.length equal to the minimum, causing all reads to access memory past the end of the payload.

items.title: CVE-2026-129801
items.summary: The FoE DATA frame handler computes the payload length from the master-supplied mailbox length field and passes it directly to FOE_fwrite. The length is checked against the remaining file capacity but not against the physical mailbox buffer size. A master can declare a large length while sending a short frame, causing FOE_fwrite to read past the end of the mailbox buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129800
items.summary: sizeOfPDO, called during state transitions, uses the subindex-0 count of the SM-assign and PDO-mapping objects as loop bounds without checking those counts against the descriptor array sizes. On builds where those subindex-0 values are writable via SDO, a master can write 0xFF and cause sizeOfPDO to read past the end of the descriptor arrays on the next transition to SAFEOP.

items.title: CVE-2026-129799
items.summary: A CoE SDO request for index 0xFFFF matches the object list terminator entry instead of returning not-found. The terminator has a NULL objdesc pointer. Callers dereference it without checking, crashing the slave.

items.title: CVE-2026-129798
items.summary: The CoE SDO segmented download handler advances a write pointer by each incoming segment's size but does not track how many bytes have been written in total. A master can keep sending non-last segments until the pointer has walked past the end of the object buffer or the complete-access staging buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129797
items.summary: SDO_downloadsegment is called whenever a mailbox frame carries the DOWNLOADSEGREQ command byte, regardless of whether a segmented download is actually in progress. ESCvar.data, which the handler writes through, is NULL until a segmented transfer is started. A master can send a DOWNLOADSEGREQ at any time and write through a NULL or stale pointer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129796
items.summary: The CoE SDO download handler for flexible-length objects (VISIBLE_STRING, OCTET_STRING, and similar) does not check that the master-declared transfer size fits within the object before writing. Two distinct writes are affected: the VISIBLE_STRING zero-padding memset and the first-frame copy into the object buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129795
items.summary: When the last EoE fragment has the TIME_APPEND flag set, the handler subtracts 4 from rxframeoffset to strip the timestamp. There is no check that rxframeoffset is at least 4. A fragment carrying fewer than 4 bytes of payload that is also marked LAST causes rxframeoffset to wrap to 0xFFFFFFFC, which is then stored as the buffer length and handed to the TCP/IP stack.

items.title: CVE-2026-129794
items.summary: The EoE fragment reassembly code uses a frame size from the wire as the bound for memcpy into the application receive buffer, without checking that the declared size fits in the actual buffer. A master can write up to 2016 bytes into a buffer the application may have sized much smaller.

Attackers can self-register a '..' user, create a '..' index, and upload release files with attacker-chosen filenames and contents into a parent of the server directory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134166
items.summary: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an unbounded memory buffering vulnerability in parseExif in lib/parse_stream/webp.js that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory via an attacker-declared EXIF chunk length. Attackers can supply a WebP stream or URL to probe(url) or probe(stream) declaring a huge EXIF length after VP8X, causing unbounded buffering and process memory exhaustion.

items.title: CVE-2026-134165
items.summary: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in lib/parse_stream/avif.js that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory via attacker-declared ftyp or meta box sizes. Attackers can supply an AVIF stream or URL to probe(url) or probe(stream) declaring a huge box length, forcing the parser to buffer all received bytes and causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-133475
items.summary: A heap-based buffer overflow was found in Corosync's Totem SRP membership commit token handling. The sanity check for memb_commit_token messages validates only minimum length and address-entry counts, not an upper bound against the fixed commit_token_storage buffer. A network-adjacent attacker who can deliver a crafted oversized commit token to a node in the GATHER membership state may overflow the heap-allocated totemsrp instance, leading to memory corruption and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-58406
items.summary: Avahi is a system which facilitates service discovery on a local network via the mDNS/DNS-SD protocol suite. In 0.9-rc4 and earlier on NetBSD architectures such as x86_64 where char is signed and the ctype guard-page change is present, avahi_domain_hash can pass a negative value to tolower when a resource-record name contains a byte at or above 128. The invalid ctype input reliably raises SIGSEGV, allowing a remote peer on the local network to crash the Avahi daemon. This issue is fixed with 0.9-rc5.

items.title: CVE-2026-131169
items.summary: When a scheduled export is copied, the permissions of the original export's owner are used when running the export. This allows users to create exports with data they usually shouldn't be able to see, but only within events they already have permissions to.

items.title: CVE-2026-131168
items.summary: A legacy code path allowed users to craft requests to a ticket shop that bypass some validation steps for the selected products. In consequence, this could lead to an attacker purchasing products that are in fact sold out.

items.title: CVE-2026-131166
items.summary: When configuring a device to use the security profile "pretixSCAN (kiosk mode, no order sync, no search)", the API search endpoint introduced in pretix 4.12 was not blocked correctly. This theoretically allows these devices to perform searches for orders even if that was not intended. If the device is in kiosk mode, the search button will still be hidden from users.

items.title: CVE-2026-131163

Results of these API calls would then be embedded in a part of the shop without proper escaping, leading to full XSS including potential session takeover.

items.title: CVE-2026-133496
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Matthias-Wandel jhead up to 3.3. This affects the function RemovePngSectionByType/RemovePngSection of the file src/pngfile.c of the component PNG Section Handler. The manipulation leads to double free. items.title: CVE-2026-127057
items.summary: The Danfoss legacy AK-SC 355 and AK-SM 800 Series are vulnerable to unauthorized access when default credentials or known passwords are used for authentication. These products were manufactured with default credentials documented in the product manual. All versions are affected.

If the workflow is completed, updates with modified content could be distributed to managed devices.

items.title: CVE-2026-99680
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: mark the inode preallocated for pNFS write layouts past EOF xfs_fs_map_blocks() marks the inode XFS_DIFLAG_PREALLOC only when it allocates blocks for a write layout. A write layout past EOF can also hand out allocated blocks, such as speculative preallocation. blockgc then frees them under the layout, and another file may get them. Mark the inode whenever a write mapping ends past EOF.

items.title: CVE-2026-99679
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: refuse a pNFS LAYOUTCOMMIT of a range without blocks A client can commit a hole in a LAYOUTCOMMIT, because nfsd does not check the extents against its layouts. xfs_iomap_write_unwritten() then allocates written blocks there. A large hole overruns the block reservation and shuts XFS down. A small one exposes stale data. Refuse such a range with -EIO, using XFS_BMAPI_CONVERT_ONLY.

items.title: CVE-2026-99678
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: cap the block count of xfs_iomap_write_direct() at one extent xfs_iomap_write_direct() reserves blocks for the whole count in an unsigned int. For a pNFS layout the client chooses that count, and an RW LAYOUTGET for 16 TiB wraps the reservation and shuts XFS down. xfs_bmapi_write() maps at most XFS_MAX_BMBT_EXTLEN blocks here, so cap the count at that. nfsd asks again for the rest. The other callers get the same mapping as before.

items.title: CVE-2026-99677
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: clamp the pNFS layout range to the maximum file size xfs_fs_map_blocks() lets two bad layout ranges through. An offset of 2^63 or more is negative and passes "offset > limit". A length above the limit, such as NFS4_UINT64_MAX, wraps "offset > limit - length" and stays unclamped. With NFS4_UINT64_MAX, a read layout is built from an uninitialized mapping. Reject a negative offset and one at the limit, and clamp the length. This needs "xfs: cap the block count of xfs_iomap_write_direct() at one extent".

items.title: CVE-2026-99662
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: mm/gup: fix out-of-bounds write for nr_pages == 0 in GUP-fast With nr_pages == 0, GUP-fast still enters its page table walk and can write past the caller's page array. The old end <= start check caught empty ranges, but was replaced with an overflow check. Users such as OrangeFS can pass a zero page count derived from a userspace-supplied length. So let's return zero for nr_pages == 0 before starting the walk, just like GUP-slow. Fix generated by an LLM and sent by Chris Mason in private. [ david: simplify description ]

items.title: CVE-2026-99661
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: mm/gup: check for overflow when converting nr_pages to bytes in GUP-fast The overflow check in gup_fast_fallback() only covers the addition to start. The preceding nr_pages << PAGE_SHIFT can already have truncated the length on 32bit. Users such as RapidIO's rio_dma_transfer() can derive such page counts from a 64-bit userspace length. Let's just check_shl_overflow() to reject any such overflow with -EOVERFLOW early.

items.title: CVE-2026-133531
items.summary: A flaw was found in cluster-network-operator. The OVN IPsec certificate signer does not verify that the requested certificate Subject and DNS names belong to the requesting node. An attacker with an accepted OVN node credential and permission to submit certificate signing requests could obtain a signed certificate identifying another node. In certificate authenticated OVN IPsec deployments, this could enable peer impersonation when the attacker can also satisfy the configured peer address check, potentially compromising protected traffic.

items.title: CVE-2026-102430

The Flex Message processing component does not adequately validate the structure of externally supplied message content. As a result, an attacker who is able to send a crafted message to a victim could cause the application to crash when the message is received or displayed. A server-side mitigation has been deployed that also protects existing iOS clients that have not been updated to version 26.19.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-133228
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When a client application enforces step-up authentication or multi-factor authentication (MFA) via a minimum authentication level, Keycloak fails to apply this requirement to login sessions initiated through the credential reset endpoint. An attacker who possesses a user's initial credentials (such as a password) can navigate from the reset interface back to the standard login form and authenticate without completing the required second factor. This flaw allows an attacker to obtain valid access tokens and gain unauthorized access to protected services without sat…

items.title: CVE-2026-133225
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When processing token requests using the User-Managed Access (UMA) grant, Keycloak fails to verify whether a target client or resource server is enabled before issuing an authorization token. An authenticated remote user can exploit this flaw to obtain valid Requesting Party Tokens (RPTs) for disabled clients, bypassing administrative access controls and permissions restrictions.

items.title: CVE-2026-133224
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When an administrator revokes tokens by setting a not-before revocation cutoff, Keycloak fails to enforce this boundary when processing User-Managed Access (UMA) grant requests using ID token claims. An authenticated remote user with an active session can submit a previously revoked ID token to receive a fresh Requesting Party Token (RPT). This flaw allows an attacker to bypass token revocation and retain unauthorized access to protected resources.

items.title: CVE-2025-71473
items.summary: lwext4 through 1.0.0 contains a heap buffer overflow in ext4_fs_init_inode_bitmap() in src/ext4_fs.c because it does not validate s_inodes_per_group against the inode bitmap size. Attackers can supply a crafted ext4 image with an oversized s_inodes_per_group so memset writes past the heap buffer, corrupting memory and crashing the mounting application.

items.title: CVE-2026-133528
items.summary: BeamNG.drive before 0.40.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability because JIT-compiled LuaJIT traces omit FFI array bounds checks, letting untrusted Lua escape the sandbox. Attackers supplying a malicious mod can JIT-compile an FFI store loop, write out of range using a tostring() address leak, re-enable ffi.load, and run commands as the game user.

items.title: CVE-2026-133521

items.title: CVE-2026-133535
items.summary: A flaw was found in Hawtio. An authenticated remote attacker can cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by sending a specially crafted request URI to monitored endpoints. The FlightRecordingDownloadFacade servlet filter uses an inefficient regular expression pattern that causes catastrophic backtracking when processing certain long requests. This issue leads to excessive CPU utilization, causing handling threads to hang and degrading service availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-61827

items.title: CVE-2026-131877
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via unbounded arc length in OBJECT IDENTIFIER decoding and encoding. The content of an OBJECT IDENTIFIER or RELATIVE-OID element is passed to unpack "w*" on decode, and the arcs of an OID string to pack "w*" on encode. Perl converts each arc to or from its decimal string in time quadratic in the arc's length, and nothing limits that length. An attacker who controls the decoded data, or an OID string passed to encode, can exhaust CPU with a single oversized arc.

items.title: CVE-2026-131868
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via a declared element length passed unchecked to sysread in asn_read and asn_get. The length an element declares in its BER header is passed to sysread as the read size. Perl grows the target buffer to that size before reading, so memory is allocated from the declared length, not from the data received. A 6-byte header can declare a length of up to 4GB. A single header makes the reading process allocate the declared size. Where the allocation fails, perl exits with "Out of memory", which eval cannot catch.

items.title: CVE-2026-126956
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via unlimited recursion depth in constructed-form string decoding. Any constructed-form string element causes the decoder to recurse on the element's contents. The BER encoding controls nesting depth at four bytes per level, with no bound checked. Perl recursion is heap-allocated, so the process grows without a stack crash. An attacker who controls the decoded data can exhaust memory with a small deeply nested constructed string.

In the constructed form each zero-length segment copies the rest of the input again, so memory grows with the square of the input size. items.title: CVE-2026-126682
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via exponent-notation string in INTEGER encoding. The encoder routes any value with abs >= 2**31 to i2osp without validating that it is an integer. A string in exponent notation such as "1e8000" passes that threshold. Math::BigInt expands it to an 8001-digit integer, and i2osp's per-octet conversion loop is quadratic in that size. An attacker who controls encoded INTEGER values can exhaust CPU with a short exponent-notation string.

When asn_decode_length returns no value because the length is absent or incomplete, no exit fires for that case either. MSG_PEEK leaves socket data unconsumed, so each re-peek returns at once while the buffer size doubles. A single t…

items.title: CVE-2026-126540
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via quadratic bigint loop in os2ip. Every INTEGER or ENUMERATED longer than four content octets reaches os2ip, which iterates over each content octet with $result = ($result * 256) + $octet. Each multiplication operates on a bigint that grows by one octet per step, so decoding an n-octet value takes O(n^2) bigint work. Nothing limits content length before this loop runs. An attacker who controls the decoded data can exhaust CPU with a single oversized INTEGER or ENUMERATED value.

items.title: CVE-2026-129934
items.summary: The MongoDB Go driver's connection string parser includes the raw, undecoded value of a query option in the error it returns when that value contains invalid percent encodings. When the option holds a secret, such as a TLS key file password or an AWS session token, the secret appears in plain text in the error. A party with low-privileged read access to wherever the application records or displays that error may learn the secret.

items.title: CVE-2026-129930
items.summary: A weakness in the MongoDB Node.js driver can place sensitive information taken from an application-supplied connection string into the text of an error produced while that connection string is being parsed. The error is generated inside the application process before any database connection is made, so no database account and no network access are needed for it to occur. A party able to read the application's error output or log files may thereby obtain database credentials that the application's configuration source would otherwise keep to a narrower audience.

items.title: CVE-2026-133435
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When configured with a database that uses case-insensitive collation, Keycloak resolves realm URLs regardless of letter casing. A remote attacker can exploit this behavior by sending requests with alternate letter casing to bypass upstream reverse proxy access controls that rely on case-sensitive path matching. This issue can expose restricted authentication endpoints intended only for internal access, though Keycloak's internal authentication mechanisms remain intact.

items.title: CVE-2026-99349
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: rxrpc: Fix lack of short-send handling in rxrpc_kernel_send_data() Fix rxrpc_kernel_send_data() to loop around if it detects a short send. David Laight suggested doing it here rather than wrapping all the calls in loops. Further, remove the len argument and use the iterator count instead and return 0 on success, not the amount copied. Note this is also a prerequisite for changing the way rxrpc_send_data() works to return a short send rather than an error if some data was buffered.

items.title: CVE-2026-99348
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: afs: Fix afs to abort the rxrpc call on send error Fix afs_send_empty_reply() and afs_send_simple_reply() to always try to abort the rxrpc call rather than just aborting on -ENOMEM and otherwise abandoning it. If the call is already complete due to network failure or a received abort, this will do nothing. Also make afs_make_call() always abort on send error; again, it does nothing if the rxrpc call is already dead.

items.title: CVE-2026-125288
items.summary: ServiceNow has addressed a code injection security issue that was identified in the ServiceNow AI Platform. This issue could enable an authenticated user with template editing privileges to execute code in the context of another user's session. ServiceNow deployed an update to hosted instances, and provided the update to our partners and self-hosted customers. We are not currently aware of malicious exploitation against ServiceNow instances. We recommend customers promptly apply appropriate updates or upgrade to a patched release if they have not already done so.

items.title: CVE-2026-129937
items.summary: The MongoDB C# Driver does not neutralize NUL characters in the user name and password values it places into the message it builds for SASL PLAIN authentication. A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. This may result in a receiving system reading a login name and secret that differ from the values the application supplied. Authenticating as a different account still requires that account's password. Only deployments that use SASL PLAIN authentication are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-133221
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. An authenticated remote user with a pending required security action, such as configuring multi-factor authentication (MFA), can bypass the mandatory action by submitting a specially crafted request to the consent endpoint without a valid session code. Keycloak incorrectly interprets the submission as a page refresh and completes the authentication process, allowing the user to access the application without fulfilling the required security policies.

items.title: Deepfake Elon Musk Nearly Scammed Crypto Users
items.summary: Scammers created a deepfake video featuring Elon Musk promoting a fake cryptocurrency giveaway. The video included a QR code and promised to double any cryptocurrency sent to the scammers. According to the discussion, hundreds of people attempted to send funds before Coinbase's AI agents identified the suspicious activity and blocked the transfers. Deepfakes are making celebrity impersonation scams increasingly convincing. Fraud detection systems are also evolving, using AI to identify suspicious transactions and intervene before money disappears. The same technology that makes scams more conv…

items.title: GPGMEに重大脆弱性CVE-2026-129975、細工したOpenPGP鍵で二重解放。Gpg4winとDebianが修正済み
items.summary: GnuPGのライブラリGPGMEに重大な脆弱性CVE-2026-129975が確認された。細工した公開鍵を処理させるとメモリの二重解放が起き、アプリケーション内部のデータが外部に流出するリスクがある。メールクライアントやFlatpakなど広範なソフトウェアが影響を受け、修正版GPGME 2.3.1が公開済み。

items.title: ext4で保存成功を返してもデータ消失　Linux 7.0由来の回帰を報告
items.summary: Linuxのファイルシステムext4で、書き込みと同期が成功を返しながらデータの一部を失う回帰が報告された。標準設定でディスクが満杯でない場合にも再現し、後の読み出しで問題が表面化する。

items.title: Debian 13.8公開、GRUB2やIntelマイクロコードなど139件のセキュリティ勧告を安定版に統合
items.summary: Debian Projectが安定版Debian 13「trixie」の8回目のポイントリリースを発表した。ブートローダーGRUB2のSecure Boot回避やCライブラリglibcの複数の脆弱性を含む139件のセキュリティ勧告と、約120パッケージの不具合修正が一つの更新時点にまとまっている。

items.title: IETF、IoT機器の一斉通信を保護するGroup OSCOREを標準化　12年前の実験仕様を置き換え
items.summary: IETFが、IoT機器がグループ単位で通信するためのRFC 10020と、その通信を暗号化・認証するGroup OSCORE（RFC 10021）を公開した。2014年にセキュリティ不在のまま出された実験仕様が廃止され、12年越しで暗号化と送信元認証を備えた標準が成立した。

items.title: RPKI信頼起点のCRLなし・有効期間100年問題にRFC 10097で統一選択規則
items.summary: RPKIの信頼起点で複数の有効な証明書が併存する場合の統一選択規則がRFC 10097として公開された。失効手段のない信頼起点では有効期間100年の証明書も残り続けていた。

items.title: Atosの認証局19件が一斉失効、RFC違反のフィールド1つが原因
items.summary: フランスのIT企業Atosが運営する認証基盤で、公開鍵証明書の国際標準に違反する記述が見つかった。Atosは対象となる下位認証局19件を11月20日に失効させたと報告している。影響を受けうる有効な証明書は、同社の申告で合計11万7,129件にのぼる。

items.title: クラウドストライク、ゼロトラスト大手Zscalerの買収を協議。合算時価総額は約2650億ドル
items.summary: クラウドストライクがゼロトラスト大手Zscaler（ゼットスケーラー）の買収を協議している。合算時価総額は約2650億ドル。サイバーセキュリティ業界史上最大規模の取引になりうるが、両社は正式にコメントしていない。

items.title: Signal、iOS 27とAndroidでAIによる画面読み取りを遮断。暗号化の「外側」を守る闘い
items.summary: SignalがiOS 27とAndroidでスクリーンショットを標準で無効にし、OSに組み込まれたAIエージェントによる画面読み取りを遮断する。対策は「不完全」とSignal自身が認めており、OS提供者に開発者向けオプトアウト手段を要求している。

items.title: 三井住友銀行で最大1400万件の情報漏えい、委託先KARTEの侵害は数百社に波及
items.summary: 三井住友銀行は11月20日、委託先プレイドのKARTE（カルテ）への不正アクセスで顧客情報が最大約1400万件漏えいしたと発表した。氏名や口座番号は含まれない。影響はKARTEを導入していた数百社に及んでいる。

items.title: Synologyの重大脆弱性CVE-2026-120382、サポート終了のDSM 6.2も影響対象。公式修正一覧から旧版が欠落
items.summary: SynologyのCVSS 9.8脆弱性SA-26:21は技術説明でDSM 6.2を影響対象に含めているが、修正一覧にDSM 6.2の行はなく、更新履歴にも修正版がない。DSM 7へ更新できない旧型NASの対応経路が見えていない。

items.title: Windows 11のロック画面を回避する「FastUnlock」、BitLocker有効環境でも影響。セキュリティ企業が確認
items.summary: Windows 11のロック画面から認証を完了せずにプログラムを実行できるゼロデイ脆弱性「FastUnlock」が公開された。BitLockerで暗号化した環境でも影響が及ぶ。エンドポイントセキュリティ企業のThreatLockerが独自に手法を検証し、再現を確認している。

items.title: DebianのAPT、旧リポジトリ形式3種を廃止へ。AIセキュリティ研究の進展で互換性より安全を優先
items.summary: APTのメンテナーが、旧リポジトリ形式3種の削除を発表した。最近のAPT脆弱性とAIセキュリティ研究の進展を受け、旧形式を維持する複雑さのリスクが互換性の利益を上回ったと判断。11月23日の週からunstableで削除作業を始める予定。

items.title: NVIDIA、ランサムウェア主張を調査中。6週間前には部品供給元も掲載されていた
items.summary: ランサムウェアグループThe Gentlemenが11月18日にNVIDIAをリークサイトに掲載した。盗んだデータの証拠は一切示されていない。NVIDIAはサードパーティパートナーへの影響を調査中で、自社システムへの侵入は否定している。同グループは6週前にNVIDIAの部品供給元も掲載しており、掲載の出どころがNVIDIA自体かサプライチェーンかは現時点で判別できない。

items.title: 英国裁判所、政府がAppleに暗号化データへのアクセスを命じた事実の公開を認める
items.summary: 英国の調査権限審判所が現地時間11月19日、政府がAppleに暗号化データへのアクセスを命じた事実を公にしても国家安全保障は損なわれないとする判決を下した。命令の適法性は2027年の本格審理に持ち越されている。

items.title: 湘南美容クリニック162万人の個人情報が流出、パスワードは暗号化されずに保存されていた
items.summary: 湘南美容クリニックなどを展開するSBCメディカルグループは11月19日、データベースへの不正アクセスで162万4000人分の個人情報が取得されたと公表した。パスワードは暗号化されずに保存されていた。外部予約サービス「トリビュー」でも56院分の予約情報が不正に閲覧された。

items.title: ASUS Control Center Express、暗号鍵のハードコードでCVSS 10.0。認証なしで管理者権限を奪われる
items.summary: ASUS Control Center Expressに暗号鍵のハードコード脆弱性。CVSS v4.0で最高値の10.0。認証なしで管理者権限を奪われ、管理下の全PCに影響が及ぶ。修正版v1.7.29への即時更新が必要になる。

items.title: Visa・Mastercard・JPMorganの顧客データ、ランサムウェアグループが公開。外部委託先が侵入経路
items.summary: ランサムウェアグループn0nが、Visa・Mastercard・JPMorgan Chaseの顧客データを公開した。カード番号の流出は確認されていない。攻撃されたのは3社の決済システムではなく、マーケティングを担う外部委託先だった。

items.title: Google、Androidアプリの開発者確認を2027年1月から全世界へ拡大。ストア外配布にも適用
items.summary: Googleが2027年1月からAndroidの開発者確認制度を全世界に広げる。Google Playだけでなく、独立系ストアやWeb経由の配布にもGoogleへの身元確認とアプリ登録が必要になる。

items.title: PHPセキュリティ更新で18件修正。FPMの接続再利用が遠隔コード実行の経路に
items.summary: PHPの全サポートブランチに18件のCVEを修正するセキュリティ更新が公開された。最も深刻なPHP-FPMの脆弱性はCVSS 9.2だが、PHP公式は非既定構成でのみ成立するとしている。

items.title: Genuen 6.1.1
items.summary: Genuen is a spin of Devuan GNU+Linux consisting exclusively of Free Software (as defined by the Free Software Foundation) and a choice of several alternative init systems, such as OpenRC, Runit, s6 and SysV. The distribution ships with the GNU Linux-libre kernel. The project provides installation images for desktop and server deployments, as well as pre-configured live images with JWM, KDE Plasma, Openbox and Xfce desktops available for the i686 and x86_64 architectures.

items.title: Oracle 10.3
items.summary: Oracle Linux is an enterprise-class Linux distribution supported by Oracle and built from source packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL). Some of the special features of Oracle Linux include a custom-build and rigorously-tested Linux kernel called "Oracle Unbreakable Kernel", tight integration with Oracle's hardware and software products including most database applications, and "zero downtime patching" - a feature that enables administrators to update the kernel without a reboot.

items.summary: LibreELEC is "just enough OS" to run the Kodi media centre. LibreELEC is a Linux distribution built to run Kodi on current and popular hardware. items.summary: kumaOS is a minimalist and immutable Fedora-based Linux distribution featuring the niri Wayland compositor and a custom-built shell called "kumaUI". The shell provides a complete desktop user interface with a top bar, an application launcher, drawer panels, a lock screen, a file manager, a terminal and a system monitor. Like most immutable distributions, kumaOS also include atomic updates and rollbacks to a previous state.

items.summary: Super Lite Linux is a customised variant of antiX, a lightweight Debian-based distribution, featuring the JWM window manager. The project's objective is to improve the user interface of antiX to make the distribution more attractive to new users.

items.summary: Armbian is a Linux distribution designed for ARM development boards. Armbian includes a menu-driven configuration tool along with stock Debian utilities, the Bash shell, and a choice of Cinnamon or Xfce desktop.

items.summary: Neko-Void is a Void-based rolling-release distribution featuring a preconfigured MATE desktop environment with carefully selected software. It is designed for users who want Void Linux's stability and minimalism with modern desktop functionality. The distribution ships with a custom system installer called Kasha Installer, and is available in two separate editions, with either X.Org or Xlibre display servers.

items.title: MidnightBSD 4.0.9
items.summary: MidnightBSD is a FreeBSD-derived operating system. A critical goal of the project is to create an easy-to-use desktop environment with graphical ports management, and system configuration using GNUstep. The vast majority of the operating system will maintain a BSD license. MidnightBSD was forked from FreeBSD 6.1 beta.

items.title: Recovering from Indirect Branch Obfuscation with Hex-Rays Microcode
items.summary: This article uses samples obfuscated with the Hikari-LLVM19 framework to present a recovery method for AArch64 indirect branch obfuscation. The method is not intended to handle all indirect branches. Different obfuscators may compute target addresses in entirely different ways, so the target resolver still needs to match the specific obfuscation semantics. However, once one or two successors can be reliably identified, the subsequent CFG completion, function range expansion, and microcode rewriting steps can be reused directly.
